title: 第5章 取死有道蓝银缠绕第6章 躺着也能变强
content_zh:
‘按照极道小说的套路……’
‘果然我现在应该先加入一个武馆苟着，在师兄弟的冷眼嘲笑里坐实主角身份！’
‘常规套路都是主角的武馆惹上帮派，然后质问对方你为什么逼我，我一步到位加入帮派是怎么回事？’
‘我这类小说套路，10个主角6个拜师武馆，2个出身渔夫，1个猎户……’
‘难道我这个帮派的就是遁去的1？’
事关生死，叶离非常严肃地思考着这个问题。
叶离在小时候，也经常会思考一些可能非常荒诞的话题。
比如自己的想法会不会被人读心，所在的世界是不是一个小说世界，自己会不会是主角之类。
但很明显，这种想法不是自己想想就能得出结论的。
不过叶离自我感觉倒是非常良好。
因为他发现自己身具无数小说的主角特质。
又或者，是那些主角拥有他的特质。
他在看小说的时候，无数次感觉这书中描写的就是我！
他完美地具备了：鸣人的身世！郑扎的智慧！路明非的气魄！古月方源的天资！楚轩的情商！
上述每一个主角，都有他的六根之一！
当初看到这些作品的时候，叶离还以为在看《我的奋斗》这种自传呢。
这简直就是我！！！
也是难为那些作者跟踪自己许久，才取材写出那些大火的作品。
这么多主角的特质缝合在叶离的身上，让他自小就感觉自己与周遭人不同。
就连周围的人也发现了他掩盖不住的特质，夸他离普通人已经太远了，说叶离简直就是个神人！

一直以来，叶离觉得，自己离主角的身份，就差一个金手指了！
毕竟没有废物的主角，只有废物的金手指！
即使是一只猪，只要获得某卢的系统，也可以起飞。
更何况叶离只是稍微神了一点，终究算得上拟人！
而如今，这【惊世智慧】正好补全了最后一块拼图！
……
带着细软，路过城内几条大街。
叶离重新回到盘踞城西的苍龙帮地界。
之所以集中住宿，也是防止门中根本的苍龙劲外流！
这并非防城内其他武馆帮派，而是防止平民习得。
整个广明城地处夏国边境，如今帝国凋敝，官方力量对此地的掌控甚至不如地方豪强。
城池处于一种名义上大夏接管的状态。
办事找本地帮派甚至效率更高。
只要能够交足相应税赋，无人在意这种帝国边角。
不闹出事来便行。
苍龙帮的习武帮众数百！势力囊括半个广明，威势滔天！
而苍龙帮的帮主，更是境界达到半步先天的高手。
像这样的高手在整个广明，便是一只手都数得出，皆是名震全城的人物！
背靠这样的势力，短期内是不用担心安危的问题了。
待叶离回到帮内，夜幕已然覆盖天穹。

白日里熠熠生辉的两颗太阳落下，凉风萧瑟吹动衣角！
按照记忆指引，叶离来到被分配的通铺，刚走近便听到里面传来的谈话声。
作为刚入帮的弟子，他自然不可能分到独立的卧房，而是与其他弟子混住。
推开门，内里并排摆放着长约7米左右的床铺。
content_en:
'Follow the routine of Yakuza novels...'
‘Sure enough, I should join a martial arts gym now to survive, and establish myself as the protagonist amidst the cold ridicule of my senior brothers! ’
‘The usual routine is that the protagonist’s martial arts gym gets into trouble with a gang, and then he asks the other party why you forced me, what’s the matter with me joining the gang in one step? ’
"The routine of my novel is that of the 10 protagonists, 6 are apprentices to martial arts schools, 2 are fishermen, and 1 is an hunter..."
‘Could it be that the members of my gang are the ones who escaped? ’
It was a matter of life and death, Ye Li thought about this issue very seriously.
When Ye Li was a child, he often thought about some potentially absurd topics.
For example, whether my thoughts can be read by others, whether the world I am in is a novel world, whether I am the protagonist, etc.
But obviously, this idea cannot be reached by just thinking about it.
However, Ye Li felt very good about himself.
Because he found himself possessing the characteristics of the protagonists of countless novels.
Or maybe it's the protagonists who possess his qualities.
When he was reading the novel, he felt countless times that the person described in the book was me!
He has it perfectly: Naruto's background! Zheng Zha’s wisdom! Lu Mingfei’s courage! Gu Yue Fang Yuan’s talent! Chu Xuan’s emotional intelligence!
Each of the above-mentioned protagonists has one of his six roots!
When he first saw these works, Ye Li thought he was reading an autobiography like "Mein Kampf".
This is simply me! ! !
It is also difficult for those authors to follow them for a long time before they write those popular works.
So many characteristics of the protagonist are stitched into Ye Li's body, making him feel that he is different from the people around him since he was a child.
Even the people around him discovered his traits that he couldn't hide, and praised him for being too far away from ordinary people. They said that Ye Li was simply a god!
Ye Li has always felt that he is only one golden finger away from being the protagonist!
After all, there is no useless protagonist, only useless golden fingers!
Even a pig can take off as long as it gets a certain Lu's system.
What's more, Ye Li is just a little bit magical, and he can be regarded as anthropomorphic after all!
And now, this [amazing wisdom] just completes the last piece of the puzzle!
…
Carrying Xinruan, we passed through several streets in the city.
Ye Li returned to the territory of the Canglong Gang that occupied the west of the city.
The reason for the centralized accommodation is to prevent the fundamental Canglong energy in the door from leaking out!
This is not to prevent other martial arts gangs in the city, but to prevent civilians from acquiring it.
The entire Guangming City is located on the border of the Xia Kingdom. Now that the empire is in decline, the official power's control over the place is not even as strong as the local power.
The city was in a state of nominal takeover by Daxia.
It's even more efficient to go to a local gang to get things done.
As long as the corresponding taxes can be paid, no one cares about this small corner of the empire.
As long as there is no trouble.
There are hundreds of Canglong Gang's martial arts gangs! The power covers half of Guangming, and the power is overwhelming!
The leader of the Canglong Gang is a master who has reached the level of half-step innateness.
There are many masters like this in Guangming on one hand, and they are all famous figures in the city!
With such a force behind us, there is no need to worry about safety in the short term.
When Ye Li returned to the gang, night had already covered the sky.
The two shining suns during the day have set, and the cool breeze is blowing the corners of my clothes!
Following the guidance of his memory, Ye Li came to the assigned Tongpu. As soon as he approached, he heard conversations coming from inside.
As a new disciple who joined the gang, he naturally could not be assigned a separate bedroom, but lived together with other disciples.
Opening the door, there are beds about 7 meters long placed side by side inside.
